concerns.quote: There should be an accelerated pathway for individuals suffering neuropenic sepsis so they are dealt with promptly
The deceased was catheterised too frequently without the management of a urologist
treatment could be expedited if patients were issued with a card noting their vulnerability and bringing with them a contact telephone number

reports.title: George Richardson
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Catheterisation was carried out including attempts/manipulation on several occasions by different individuals without recourse to a consolidated catheterisation record

links.explanation: Both reports highlight problems with repeated or multiple catheterisation procedures performed without proper oversight or documentation. The earlier report stresses excessive frequency without urologist involvement, while the later report notes lack of a consolidated record leading to uncoordinated attempts.
